segments.text: The 7th National Expenditure Program of the Department of Health and its attached agencies is hereby called to order.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I would like to acknowledge the presence of senators who are present with us today.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I would like to acknowledge Senator Panfilo Lacson and, of course, Senator Raffy Tulfo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, sir, for joining us this morning.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At this juncture, let me direct the Committee Secretary to acknowledge the resource persons present for today.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Good morning. The Chair would like to first give his opening statement, then I would ask my colleagues also.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Today, we take up the proposed 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Of the Department of Health and its attached agencies and corporations.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Health is one of the clearest tests of whether a national budget is working for the ordinary Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ramdam agad ito kapag pumunta sila sa health center, pampublikong ospital, pharmacy, or PhilHealth accredited facility.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I have never denied my bias towards healthcare.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As author and principal sponsor of the Universal Healthcare Act, I want UHC to succeed and fulfill its promises.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But it can only do so...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: If it is sufficiently funded and properly implemented.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: In a sheer twist of fate, this humble representation became the Chair of the Senate Committee on Finance and will defend the budget of the Department of Health.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I was fortunate enough to have worked with the Secretary of Health when he was field head president.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And the one who took over his role was instrumental in drafting the UHC.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Dr. Beverly Ho was one of the assistants.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The secretaries of the UH when we were drafting and deliberating on the universal healthcare.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Of course, I would like also to acknowledge Usec Albert Domingo, who was then with...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: who was also with us as we were passing the universal health care.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: That's why I can say it's like a dream team for UHC to have Dr. Ed Mercado as secretary

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: who really has improved the operations of field health and implementation of UHC under his administration.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, I'm very happy to have Secretary Mercado, Dr. Bevo, Yuseg Domingo, and the rest of the officials of the DOH

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: who are really pro-universal health care.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngayon tayo na ang chair ng Senate Committee on Finance.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Malinaw na ang nais nating makita sa budget na ito, hindi lamang mas malaking pondo,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: kundi ang mas accessible na serbisyong pangkalusugan

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at mas mababang medical out-of-pocket expense.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The UHC Act requires us to shift toward primary and preventive care

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: rather than relying predominantly on hospital-based treatment.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya kailangan nating palakasin ang primary health care sa ating mga komunidad,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: kasabay ang pagpapaayos ng ating mga provincial hospitals,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngayon po ay napaganda natin through the years

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: itong mga apex hospitals o mga DOH-run hospitals dahil sa budget na rin ng specialty centers

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Gusto rin nating makita ang mas malakas na PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: a PhilHealth which can give benefit packages that reflect the actual health needs of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Gusto rin nating matiyak ang pagpapataas pa ng PhilHealth participation sa mga hospital bills,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: upang mapababa ang out-of-pocket expense ng bawat pasyente.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: gusto natin mabigyang prayoridad ang health care ng bawat Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ang malusog na mamamayan ay isang mamamayan na makapag-aambag sa pag-unlad ng bayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Universal health care was enacted so that every Filipino can receive health services

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Our task today is to determine whether the proposed 2027 budget,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: truly brings us closer to that promise,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: not only on paper, but in the patient's actual experience.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So I hope that the department and its attached agencies can give us clear targets,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: By the end of this hearing, we should know what a Filipino patient

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: should concretely expect from this budget,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: how much less he or she should have to pay out of pocket,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and which programs Congress must strengthen to make those results possible.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We assure that, this budget hearing, sabi ko nga po, bias po ako, but we will give health care programs

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At ito po yung talagang ramdam ng taong bayan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: whatever challenges that our country is facing,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: hangga't ramdam po nila na andiyan po ang gobyerno para umalalay po sa

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: lalo na sa pagkakasakit, ay malaking bagay po yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'm looking forward to a very productive hearing.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So I'd like to ask our colleagues,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Senator Panfilo Lacson first to give his statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: None from this representation, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Since I became Senator at tuwing magkakaroon ng budget hearing sa Department of Health,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: lagi ko pong kini-kwestiyon bakit walang palya

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: nagkakaroon ng mga gamot na nag-expire.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Not only by the hundreds of millions, but by the billions B, billions of pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Samantalang maraming mga health centers tayo na sumisigaw na kulang sila sa gamot.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Maraming mga may hirap natin kababayan ng kakamatay na dahil hindi nakakarating sa kanila

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung mga gamot na they deserve.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: At ang palaging sinasabi ng DOH,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: ito raw ay nagkakaroon sila ng konting oversight, ang reason.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: sinusoli naman daw sa mga supplier.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: ngayong araw na ito, right now,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung kasinungalingan ng DOH for so many years

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: May ebidensya ako na yung mga gamot na yun ay binabaon.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: I have pictures here that will show

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: i-reserve ko na muna ang katanungan ko later on

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And I have proof to show that.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nawala na nga itong si Teston.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: By the person of Franklin Tabakin.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: May kaso ka sa ombudsman, di po ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bakit ikaw, huwag ka na magsumagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: mas qualified pa sa iyo sa FDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: At alam nila ins and outs ng FDA.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung saang impyerno ka nang galing,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: dahil ang lakas mo kay Teston.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: na ikaw raw ang gagawing director general.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dahil lamang sa ikaw ay bata-sirada ni Teston.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mamaya sa mga questions na lang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Since there are no more questions

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: may we request the Department of Health

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: will be given to the officials

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: our Chair of the Committee on Finance

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: good morning to all of us.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ay along the lines din po

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ng ating universal health care law.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ay for the first time po

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: na kung saan naman po talaga

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: and ang tawag po namin dito

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: kasi ang gayak po namin gawin

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: uulitin na naman yung CT scan

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: dun pa rin po sa HAYA

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: pag-uusapan pa po ng House of Congress, both House, Lower House and Upper House.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pero kung ikukumpara po natin yung ating 2026 NEP doon po sa nakaraang 2026 GAA, ito po yung mas mababa ng 21.2%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po yung breakdown naman according to our three buckets ng ating usual expense.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang PS po, which is the salaries and wages, personal salary PS, is at P218 billion, which is the largest share, and 20% higher than the previous 2026 NEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang ating pong, sorry, yung pula po ang maintenance and other operating expense, sorry po, MOOE po yun.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang nakasama din po yung capital, yung pong ating mga GOCC hospitals at DOH hospitals.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang personal service po ay 7% higher than 2026 NEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ang capital outlay, ito po yung medyo bumaba kumpara po nung nakaraang 2026 NEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ay composed ng P14.5 billion for HPEP and P4.2 billion po doon sa Health System Resilience Project na ito po ay loan natin sa World Bank.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At nakalaan sa 17 probinsya po na identified na nitong World Bank loan natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung ating, kung ating pong i-divide na yung buong 353 budget po ng DOH, ito nga po yung limang pillars.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung para po doon sa unang pillar na Healthy School Workplace and Communities.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang malaking portion po dito, or 55.4 per billion, ay yung share po ng PhilHealth Premium to cover the indirect contributor.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: 30.7 million po ang aming nakalap na dami.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ng ating registered indirect contributor.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: P2.5 billion po for health promotion.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Short pa rin po ng mandated na 1%, but ito po ay tumaas na significantly compared ng mga nakaraang taon na halos dumoble.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And then P1.3 billion po dito sa ating health emergency preparedness.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Dahil alam po natin, bunga nitong global warming, marami po tayo ngayong mga na-experience.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Kagaya nga po nitong haze, ito pong pagbaha, at saka po itong surge po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So kung titignan naman po natin yung performance noong 2025,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: ang ating pong fully immunized ay 2 out of 3 children.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Hindi rin po ito umabot noong target natin na 95%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po yung pinagtutuunan ko ng pansin, kasi karamihan po dito ay yung commodities po ay hindi dumating ng oras.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Para pagpambabakuna na inaayos na rin po natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: 8 out of 10 children, age 2 and below, had adequate height for their age.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po naman yung sukatan natin ng stunting.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ay nasa 21.1% na ibaba na po natin kumpara noong 22.5% noong 2023.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And then 8 out of 10 households had access to basic water supply.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ay 82.74% ng kabuang household.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Medyo falling short pa rin po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At 7 out of 10 Filipinos had access to family planning needs.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ito po ay nahigitan yung ating target na 64.5%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ang ating pong nabigyan ng TB meds ay 367,000.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ito po ay 85% po ng ating accomplishment, which is our target.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At accomplishment target na na-achieve naman po natin.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At higit 100,000 po, living with HIV, ang nakatanggap po ng treatment.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At ito po ay 66% accomplishment versus our target of 70%.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: 15,000 cancer patients po ang naka-access ng ating essential medicines and palliative care.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At 262,000 individuals naman po ang nakatanggap po ng mental health medicines and intervention.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sa ating pong PILAR 2, which is the Functional Primary Care Services,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: system, 9.1 billion po ang for family health, immunization, nutrition, and responsible parenting.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So tinahina po namin ito ngayon doon sa ating YACA program,

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: kung saan po papalawigin din eventually na magkaroon din ang access doon sa ating commodities for family planning.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At nakasentro po ito sa TB at HIV.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Again, nag-uusap na po kami ni PCO Bevho kung paano din po maisama itong mga commodities.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Sa ating YACAP gamot at para rin din po makover yung ating testing ng HIV.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung 2.7 billion po ay for non-communicable diseases, which includes hypertension, diabetes, mental health.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Again, ito po ay isasama din ni Doktora Bev sa pagpapalawak ng gamot.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At 1.5 billion for local health systems development.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Upang suportahan po yung 18 regyon, lalong-lalo na po yung 110 UHM.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Dito naman po sa Pillar 3, which is the quality and efficient hospitals.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nakita po natin na nung nakaraang taon, record high pong 300 billion ang benefit payment na nailabas ng PhilHealth.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ito po ay 82% increase from the previous year.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Na nagpapatunay nga po kung bakit bumaba yung out-of-pocket spending ng mga Pilipino nung nakaraang taong 2025.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: kasama na po yung 40 million na Pilipinos registered with the YACAP nung nakaraang taon po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Yung pong nakatanggap ng ma-EFIP ay 4.3 million.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Out of which, 4.3 million patients in 2025.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And then these are served, 32,000 plus patients served through e-MA-EFIP na po.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So nagsishift na po tayo to e-MA-EFIP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Pinupisaan lang po ito nung August.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At sa mula po nung August, mag-iisang buwan.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At sa mula pa lang po, 32,000 na po ang dito natin na i-process sa e-MA-EFIP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At kami po ay nagpapalawig at atin pong inumpisahan sa DOH hospitals.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Ngayon po ay isasama na po natin yung mga local government unit hospitals.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: At nakita naman po na mas mabilis na po yung ating processing.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: 54,000 cancer patients po ang nakareceive ng Cancer Assistance Fund.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Nearly 2,000 health infrastructure projects were completed in the last 2 years, 3 years, 23 to 25.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: And almost 5,000 medical equipments were procured.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: Lahat po ito kasaming 500 medical transport vehicles are done through our HVEP.

segments.speaker: Secretary Edwin M. Mercado
segments.text: So ang nandito rin po sa Pillar 3 ay yung operations po ng ating 71 regional hospitals and health facilities.

segments.text: We're talking about the next generation.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
